description: Flutter findu_proveedores: BiometricVerifier port + dev MOCK (replace the hardcoded Unsplash URL) + documented real ML Kit/TFLite impl behind the same interface; route the register wizard biometric step through the port and POST the result to the security activation endpoint; profile shows 'usuario no activo' banner + the 2 INFO alerts (biometric one with CTA navigating in-app to the biometric screen) consumed from backend/engine, each disappearing as its flag flips; realtime handler branches on payload['templateCode']; frontal profile photo read-only; login not blocked. Depends on FEAT-001's contract; sequenced last. Covers plan.md items 9-11. NOTE: shared findu-movil/packages/* are unversioned — document any change there.
steps: Biometric abstraction (plan item 9): add features/auth_onboarding/domain/ports/biometric_verifier.dart (BiometricVerifier: readCedula, captureAndDetectFace, matchFaces + result value objects per design 8.1); infrastructure/adapters/mock_biometric_verifier.dart (configurable success/failure, returns the real captured/picked image path + configurable OCR name/date, NO remote placeholder); infrastructure/adapters/mlkit_tflite_biometric_verifier.dart (real impl, documented, dev-stubbed, selected by BIOMETRIC_MODE=real; mock default). Remove the hardcoded Unsplash URL from biometric_verification_service.dart. Add BIOMETRIC_MODE to lib/core/config/environment.dart via String.fromEnvironment.

Register wizard + submit (plan item 10): route register_wizard_screen.dart biometric step through the injected BiometricVerifier (replace the direct BiometricVerificationService field ~line 94 and the pickDocumentImage call ~line 1231); on success POST {cedulaNombre,cedulaFechaNacimiento,faceMatched,faceMatchScore,fotoFrontalUrl} to POST /security-auth/api/v1/activation/biometric via a new activation_api_adapter.dart (or extend auth_api_adapter.dart) using RestHttpClient(base Environment.gatewayUrl, JWT header pattern from profile_api_adapter.dart); keep biometric optional/deferrable; normalize accents client-side for feedback only; inject the chosen BiometricVerifier at the composition root in main.dart.

Profile banner + alerts + realtime (plan item 11): in provider_profile_screen.dart read estadoActivacion/emailOk/biometriaOk/fotoPerfilFrontalUrl from the security profile (extend ProviderFullProfile + profile_api_adapter.dart parsing); show 'Usuario no activo' badge when estadoActivacion != ACTIVADO; fetch alert content via the gateway from the processor GET /api/v1/templates/alertas?pantalla=perfil_proveedor&language=es (new alert-fetch adapter); evaluate condicion_aparicion with a small evaluator supporting {emailOk,biometriaOk,otpOk,soporteOk} and ==/!= vs true/false; render matches sorted by prioridad; each alert disappears when its flag flips (tiempo_desaparicion=0 => no timer); bind the biometric alert cta_action to IN-APP navigation to the biometric screen (app has no URL router; map the stable cta_action id); add a realtime handler (network_ws Stream<Map> pattern from market_api_adapter.dart) branching on payload['templateCode']: PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO -> refresh profile, PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO -> show payload['motivo']; make the frontal photo widget read-only when fotoPerfilFrontalUrl is set; do NOT change login.
Add pure-Dart unit tests: MockBiometricVerifier configurable outcomes; alert-visibility evaluator (flags -> which alerts show). Never run on a device/emulator.
acceptance_criteria: cd findu-movil/apps/findu_proveedores && flutter analyze reports no new errors in touched files/packages.
flutter test passes for the new pure-Dart unit tests (and existing ones).
No remote placeholder/Unsplash URL remains in the biometric flow; the captured/picked image path is used.
Login still enters the app when the provider is non-active; the frontal profile photo is read-only once set.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED in findu-movil/apps/findu_proveedores (own git repo, branch master). Backend FEAT-001 security contract is the integration target; no backend files touched here.

FILES ADDED:
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/domain/ports/biometric_verifier.dart (BiometricVerifier port + CedulaOcrResult/FaceCaptureResult/FaceMatchResult VOs per design 8.1).
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/infrastructure/adapters/mock_biometric_verifier.dart (default dev/CI; configurable OCR name/date + success/failure outcomes; returns the real captured local image path, NO remote/Unsplash URL).
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/infrastructure/adapters/mlkit_tflite_biometric_verifier.dart (real impl, documented, dev-stubbed; methods throw UnimplementedError so BIOMETRIC_MODE=real never produces fake data until native wiring is done; full ML Kit/TFLite + arm64 wiring documented in header).
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/infrastructure/adapters/biometric_verifier_factory.dart (composition root selecting mock vs real by Environment.biometricMode).
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/infrastructure/adapters/activation_api_adapter.dart (POST /security-auth/api/v1/activation/biometric via RestHttpClient base Environment.gatewayUrl + X-JWT-Algorithm header; parses {biometriaOk,motivo}; also GET /activation/status).
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/presentation/screens/biometric_verification_screen.dart (standalone in-app biometric screen the profile alert CTA navigates to; drives the port + activation submit).
- lib/core/utils/accent_normalizer.dart (client-side accent-insensitive normalize, feedback only; backend re-validates).
- lib/features/profile/domain/entities/profile_alert.dart (ALERTA template model).
- lib/features/profile/domain/services/alert_condition_evaluator.dart (evaluator for condicion_aparicion over {emailOk,biometriaOk,otpOk,soporteOk} with ==/!= vs true/false; sorts by prioridad; empty=visible, unknown/malformed=hidden).
- lib/features/profile/domain/services/activation_realtime_handler.dart (branches on payload['templateCode']: PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO/PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO; tolerant of root/nested payload).
- lib/features/profile/infrastructure/adapters/profile_alert_api_adapter.dart (GET /api/v1/templates/alertas?pantalla=perfil_proveedor&language=es via gateway; returns [] on failure, no hardcoded copy).
- test/mock_biometric_verifier_test.dart, test/alert_condition_evaluator_test.dart, test/activation_realtime_handler_test.dart (21 pure-Dart tests).

FILES EDITED:
- lib/core/config/environment.dart: added BIOMETRIC_MODE (String.fromEnvironment, default 'mock') + isBiometricReal getter.
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/presentation/screens/register_wizard_screen.dart: replaced the direct BiometricVerificationService field with an injected BiometricVerifier (DI via new optional constructor param, defaults to BiometricVerifierFactory at the composition root in initState); _pickDocument no longer calls the removed service (uses a real local path, no remote URL); _showFacialBiometricDialog success now runs _runBiometricVerification() which drives readCedula/captureAndDetectFace/matchFaces and POSTs to the activation endpoint (biometric stays optional/deferrable, non-fatal on failure); accent normalization used for local feedback.
- lib/features/profile/domain/entities/provider_full_profile.dart: added estadoActivacion, otpOk, emailOk, biometriaOk, soporteOk, fotoPerfilFrontalUrl (parsed from securityUser), isNoActivo getter, copyWith updates.
- lib/features/profile/presentation/screens/provider_profile_screen.dart: 'Usuario no activo' badge when estadoActivacion != ACTIVADO; fetches + renders visible INFO alerts (biometric alert CTA navigates in-app to BiometricVerificationScreen); handleRealtimeMessage branches on templateCode (activado->refresh, rechazado->show motivo+refresh); frontal profile photo made read-only (_showEditPhotoDialog blocked when fotoPerfilFrontalUrl set); login not touched.

FILES REMOVED:
- lib/features/auth_onboarding/domain/services/biometric_verification_service.dart (contained the hardcoded Unsplash URL; replaced by the port; it had no other importers).

UNVERSIONED packages/* CHANGES: NONE. packages/network_rest, packages/network_ws, packages/ui_kit were only read, not modified. (Note: packages/network_ws/lib/network_ws.dart is a stub with no real WebSocket connection; the realtime handler is implemented as a pure classifier that consumes the Map payload, matching the market_api_adapter broadcast-stream pattern. No real WS wiring exists in the app yet and wiring it is out of FEAT-005 scope.)

ENVIRONMENT NOTES: The API gateway currently has NO route to findu-notification-processor (verified ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway application.yml/application-qa.yml), so GET /api/v1/templates/alertas is not yet reachable through the gateway; ProfileAlertApiAdapter degrades to an empty alert list in that case (no hardcoded copy per design 7.4 variant B). Provisioning that gateway route + the processor endpoint is backend work outside this mobile FEAT.

VERIFICATION (run from findu-movil/apps/findu_proveedores):
- flutter analyze -> exit 1 with 48 issues, ALL severity 'info' (no errors/warnings). The three issues on my new/edited lines were: alert_condition_evaluator doc-comment angle brackets (fixed) and provider_profile_screen withOpacity deprecations (kept to match the file's existing pervasive withOpacity style). All other info lints (withOpacity, use_null_aware_elements, prefer_final_fields) are pre-existing project-wide patterns. No NEW errors introduced.
- flutter test test/mock_biometric_verifier_test.dart test/alert_condition_evaluator_test.dart test/activation_realtime_handler_test.dart -> All 21 new tests passed.
- flutter test (full suite) -> 31 passed, 1 failed: the PRE-EXISTING default scaffold test test/widget_test.dart ('renders login screen initially') asserts find.text('findu') but main.dart shows a CircularProgressIndicator splash (_StartupSplash) during the async auth check after a single pump; this test is unrelated to FEAT-005 (no changes to main.dart or login_screen rendering) and was already broken against the current startup flow.
- NEVER ran on a device/emulator.

COMMIT: committed locally on master in the findu_proveedores repo; NOT pushed.
